# TW Framework — Complete Reference for AI Coding Assistants
# Source: https://github.com/ffakraj-ui/twlang
# Version: v0.9.17 (2026-08-12)
# Rule: If README and source code disagree, trust the source code and tests.

---

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW

TW Framework (package: `tw-framework` on PyPI) is a Python-based full-stack web framework with App Router, Zero-JS static sites, NPM package manager, React compatibility, and esbuild bundling.

- **Language**: Custom DSL (`.tw` pages/components/layouts, `.tss` stylesheets, `.twm` API routes)
- **Runtime**: Python (compiler + dev server + CLI). API routes (`.twm`) run on Node.js/Edge V8/Python/WASM.
- **Package manager**: `pip install tw-framework` (Python). NPM packages via `tw install` command.
- **File extensions**: `.tw` (pages/components/layouts), `.tss` (stylesheets), `.twm` (API routes/lib modules), `.js`/`.ts` (client libraries), `.twp` (plugins)
- **Project root marker**: `tw.config` file
- **Source folder**: `[home]/` (literal brackets — App Router root)
- **Build output**: `dist/`
- **Cache dir**: `.tw/cache/`
- **Version**: 0.9.17
- **Author**: KANISHK KUMAR (mlkraj290@gmail.com)
- **License**: MIT

### 1.1 Installation
```bash
pip install tw-framework
```

Optional features (zero hard dependencies in core):
```bash
pip install tw-framework[image]        # Pillow — image optimization, srcset
pip install tw-framework[compression]  # brotli — production pre-compression
pip install tw-framework[edge-v8]       # py_mini_racer — V8 JS sandbox runtime
pip install tw-framework[redis]        # redis — distributed SSR cache
pip install tw-framework[wasm]         # wasmtime — WebAssembly sandbox runtime
pip install tw-framework[all]           # All optional features combined
pip install tw-framework[dev]           # pytest — testing
```

### 1.2 Quick Start
```bash
pip install tw-framework
tw create my-site
cd my-site
tw dev          # dev server at 127.0.0.1:3000
```

### 1.3 Build & Deploy
```bash
tw build        # outputs to dist/
tw serve        # production SSR server at 0.0.0.0:8000
tw deploy --provider vercel --prod
```

---

## 2. PROJECT STRUCTURE

```
my-site/
  tw.config              # project config (key: value, indentation-based)
  .env                   # environment variables
  middleware.tw          # middleware (auth, headers, rate limiting, rewrites)
  [home]/                 # App Router root (literal brackets)
    layout.tw            # root layout (wraps all pages)
    page.tw              # home page (/)
    not-found.tw         # 404 page
    error.tw             # error page
    loading.tw           # loading page
    style.tss            # global stylesheet
    about/page.tw        # /about
    blog/page.tw         # /blog (index)
    blog/[slug]/page.tw  # /blog/:slug (dynamic route)
    blog/posts.json      # data for generateStaticParams
    counter/page.tw      # /counter (reactive state)
    contact/page.tw      # /contact (form)
    components/           # reusable components
      Navbar.tw
      Footer.tw
      Button.tw
      Card.tw
    api/                  # API routes
      contact/route.tw   # POST /api/contact
      users/route.tw     # GET /api/users
  dist/                  # build output
  public/                # static files (served as-is)
  .tw/                   # internal cache dir
    cache/
    manifest/
```

## 4. PAGE BLOCK DIRECTIVES (from compiler.py parse_page_block)

```tw
page {
    title "My Page"
    render static              # static | server | edge | interactive | dynamic | csr
    revalidate 60              # ISR: revalidate every 60 seconds
    cache_by "cookie:session"  # cache by cookie/header/query
    cache_size 256             # max cache entries per namespace (default 512)
    generateStaticParams "../posts.json"  # dynamic route data source
    redirect "/new-path"      # redirect this page
    rewrite "/other-page"     # rewrite URL
    layout "base,docs"        # DEPRECATED — use file-based layout.tw
}
```

### Render Modes

| Mode | Description | Output |
|------|-------------|--------|
| `static` | SSG — build-time HTML (default) | Pure HTML, zero JS |
| `server` | SSR — per-request server render | Dynamic HTML on each request |
| `edge` | Edge runtime via V8 sandbox | JS handler in V8 isolate |
| `interactive` | TW native VDOM (~3KB) | Zero-JS by default, reactive on demand |
| `dynamic` | Auto-detect static vs server | Smart routing |
| `csr` | Full React CSR | React ecosystem, client-side hydration |

---

## 5. SYNTAX — .tw FILES

### 5.1 Page Block
```tw
page {
    title "My Page"
    render static
}
```

### 5.2 Elements
```tw
body {
    div { class "container"
        h1 "Hello World"
        p { class "subtitle", text "Welcome to TW" }
        a { href "/about", text "About Us" }
    }
}
```

### 5.3 Components
```tw
component Button {
    props {
        href: string = ""
        label: string = "Click"
        variant: string = "primary"
    }
    style {
        .btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; }
    }
    body {
        a { class: "btn btn-{{variant}}", href: "{{href}}", text: "{{label}}" }
    }
}
```

### 5.4 Conditionals
```tw
if condition {
    p "Visible when true"
}
else {
    p "Visible when false"
}
```

### 5.5 Loops
```tw
each items as item {
    li "{{item.name}}"
}
```

### 5.6 Let Bindings
```tw
let greeting = "Hello"
let count = 42
```

### 5.7 Reactive State
```tw
state {
    count 0
    name "World"
}
```

### 5.8 Event Handlers
```tw
Button { label "Increment", on:click "increment" }
```

### 5.9 Server Actions
```tw
actions {
    fn increment(state) {
        state.count = state.count + 1
    }
}
```

### 5.10 Head Block
```tw
head {
    meta { charset "utf-8" }
    meta { name "viewport", content "width=device-width, initial-scale=1" }
    seo {
        description "Page description"
    }
}
```

### 5.11 Layouts (file-based)
```tw
page {
    title "My Site"
    render static
}

load "@./style.tss"

head {
    meta { charset "utf-8" }
    meta { name "viewport", content "width=device-width, initial-scale=1" }
}

body {
    Navbar {}
    main { class "main-content"
        children
    }
    Footer {}
}
```

---

## 6. TSS — TW STYLE SYSTEM (.tss files)

```tss
:root {
    --bg: #ffffff;
    --text: #1a1a1a;
    --primary: #3b82f6;
}

body {
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root {
        --bg: #0f172a;
        --text: #e2e8f0;
    }
}
```

Components have scoped CSS via `style { }` blocks — styles don't leak.

---

## 7. TWM — API ROUTES (.twm files)

### 7.1 Basic API Route
```twm
runtime = "nodejs"

fn get(request) {
    return {
        status: 200,
        body: { message: "Hello from API" }
    }
}

fn post(request) {
    const data = request.body
    return {
        status: 201,
        body: { created: true }
    }
}
```

### 7.2 Runtime Directives
- `runtime = "nodejs"` — persistent Node.js worker (default)
- `runtime = "edge"` — V8 sandbox via py_mini_racer
- `runtime = "python"` — Python in-process
- `runtime = "wasm"` — wasmtime sandbox
- `runtime = "edge-py"` — legacy Python edge fallback

### 7.3 Common API Layer (tw.*)
```javascript
tw.storage.read(path)           // fs on Node, KV on Edge
tw.storage.write(path, data)
tw.storage.delete(path)
tw.storage.exists(path)
tw.http.fetch(url, options)     // returns {ok, status, statusText, headers, text, data}
tw.http.get(url, headers, timeout)
tw.http.post(url, body, headers, timeout)
tw.crypto.hash("sha256", data)
tw.crypto.hmac("sha256", key, message)
tw.crypto.random(length)
tw.crypto.uuid()
tw.cache.get(key, defaultVal)
tw.cache.set(key, value, ttl)
tw.cache.delete(key)
tw.cache.has(key)
tw.env.get(name, defaultVal)
tw.env.all()
tw.env.has(name)
tw.runtime.name()
tw.runtime.capabilities()
tw.runtime.supports(capability)
```

---

## 8. MIDDLEWARE (middleware.tw)

### 8.1 Rule-based middleware
```tw
use {
    match "/dashboard/**"
    header "X-Content-Type-Options" "nosniff"
    header "X-Frame-Options" "DENY"
}

rule "api-rate-limit" {
    match "/api/**"
    rate_limit { requests 100, window 60 }
}

rule "auth-required" {
    match "/admin/**"
    auth { cookie "session" }
}
```

### 8.2 Function-based middleware
```tw
fn before(ctx) {
    if (ctx.path.startsWith("/admin") && !ctx.session) {
        return { redirect: "/login" }
    }
}

fn after(ctx) {
    ctx.response.headers["X-Response-Time"] = ctx.duration + "ms"
}
```

### 8.3 Middleware capabilities
- Path matching: prefixes, contains, extensions, regex, single_segment_max, deny_traversal, deny_null_bytes
- Headers: custom security/response headers
- Methods: restrict HTTP methods
- Auth: cookie-based, JWT (secret or env var)
- Rate limiting: token bucket per IP/identity, configurable window and capacity
- User agent: allow/block/empty_is_blocked
- Origin: CORS allow/require/allow_referer
- Redirect/rewrite: URL redirection and rewriting
- Custom response: status, json, html, text, content_type, headers, cookies

---

## 9. APP ROUTER (app_router.py)

### Route segment types:
- **Static**: `about/` → `/about`
- **Dynamic**: `[slug]/` → `/:slug`
- **Catch-all**: `[...slug]/` → `/*`
- **Optional catch-all**: `[[...slug]]/` → `/*?`
- **Route group**: `(group)/` → group without URL segment

### Special files:
- `page.tw` — page component
- `layout.tw` — layout (wraps child pages, supports nesting)
- `not-found.tw` — 404 page
- `error.tw` — error page
- `loading.tw` — loading page
- `route.tw` — API route (in `api/` directory)

### Layout chain:
Layouts are nested — `find_layouts_for_dir()` walks up from the page's directory to `[home]/`, collecting all `layout.tw` files. `children` slot is replaced by the child page's content.

---

## 10. SECURITY (security.py)

### Functions:
- `generate_csp_nonce()` — cryptographically secure nonce
- `build_csp_header(nonce, extra_directives)` — CSP header with directive dedup
- `sanitize_html(html)` — XSS prevention with double-escape protection
- `sanitize_js_string(js)` — JS string sanitization
- `sanitize_url(url)` — prevents javascript: and data: injection
- `sanitize_attribute(attr, value)` — href/src sanitization
- `generate_csrf_token()` — CSRF token generation
- `validate_csrf_token(token, expected)` — CSRF validation

### Server-side security:
- Security headers on all responses: X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
- Request body size limit (default 10MB via TW_MAX_BODY_SIZE)
- Env var filtering for Edge runtime (TW_, PUBLIC_, EDGE_ prefixes only)
- V8 execution timeout (30s)
- Authenticated encryption (scrypt + HMAC-SHA256)

---

## 11. PRODUCTION SERVER (server.py)

### `run_production_server(project_root, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, output_dir=None, workers=None)`

Features:
- SSR for render server/edge pages
- Static file serving from dist/ with ETag and Cache-Control
- Brotli/gzip pre-compressed file negotiation (Accept-Encoding)
- API route execution (Node.js, Edge V8, Python, WASM)
- Middleware chain execution
- WebSocket support
- Health check at /__tw/health
- Graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT shutdown
- AST cache with TTL (TW_AST_CACHE_MAX=128, TW_AST_CACHE_TTL=300)
- SSR cache: in-memory LRU (SSRCache) or Redis (RedisSSRCache via TW_REDIS_URL)
- Configurable max fetch passes (TW_MAX_FETCH_PASSES=10)
- V8 execution timeout (30s via daemon thread)
- HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD
- Pre-compressed .br and .gz file support
- Last-Modified conditional requests

### SSR Cache:
- `SSRCache(max_entries=512)` — in-memory LRU with TTL, thread-safe via threading.Lock
- `RedisSSRCache(redis_url, ttl=3600)` — Redis-backed, falls back to SSRCache if Redis unavailable
- Cache namespaces with configurable max entries per namespace
- `TW_SSR_CACHE_MAX` env var for cache size

---

## 12. BUILD PIPELINE (compiler.py — 6863 lines)

### Pipeline stages:
1. **Lexing** — tokenize .tw source (lexer.py)
2. **Parsing** — build AST (parser.py): page, element, component, if, for, each, let, script, head blocks
3. **Semantic analysis** — type checking, scope resolution (semantic.py)
4. **IR lowering** — intermediate representation (lowering.py)
5. **HTML rendering** — generate static HTML (render_html.py)
6. **CSS rendering** — scoped stylesheets, TSS compilation
7. **JS bundling** — client-side runtime, code splitting (client_bundler.py)
8. **Dead code detection** — unused pages, components, APIs (dead_code.py)
9. **Tree shaking** — remove unused exports (tree_shaking.py)
10. **Minification** — HTML, CSS, JS minification
11. **Output** — write to dist/

### Build options:
- `--workers` — parallel compilation (default: max(1, min(32, cpu_count)))
- `--watch` — rebuild on file change (HMR)
- `--analyze` — bundle analysis
- `--report` — build report
- `--strict` — treat warnings as errors
- `--adapter` — vercel/netlify/cloudflare output format
- `--prod` — production optimizations (brotli compression, SRI hashes)

### Key constants:
- `BUILD_MANIFEST_VERSION = 2`
- `DEPENDENCY_GRAPH_VERSION = 2`
- `CHUNKS_URL_PREFIX = "/_tw/static/chunks/"`
- `DEFAULT_WORKERS = max(1, min(32, os.cpu_count() or 1))`

---

## 13. MULTI-RUNTIME (tw_runtime/)

### Runtime registry:
- `RuntimeRegistry.register(name, runtime_class)` — register a runtime
- `get_runtime(name)` — get runtime instance
- `list_runtimes()` — list all registered runtimes
- `DEFAULT_RUNTIME = "nodejs"`
- `register_runtimes()` — thread-safe auto-registration (called on import, idempotent with double-check lock)

### Runtime capabilities (RuntimeCapability enum):
- FILESYSTEM, NETWORK, NATIVE_MODULES, SUBPROCESS, DATABASE
- CRYPTO, CACHE, ENV_VARS, PERSISTENT_STORAGE, TIMERS, STREAMING

### Runtime adapters:

| Runtime | Key | Engine | Capabilities |
|---------|-----|--------|-------------|
| Node.js | `nodejs`/`node` | Persistent Node.js worker | fs: Y, net: Y, subprocess: Y, crypto: Y |
| Edge V8 | `edge`/`edge-v8` | V8 isolate (py_mini_racer) | fs: N, net: Y, crypto: Y, timers: N |
| Python | `python` | Python in-process | fs: Y, net: Y, subprocess: Y |
| WASM | `wasm` | wasmtime sandbox | fs: N, net: N, crypto: Y |
| Edge (legacy) | `edge-py` | Python in-process | fs: N, net: Y, crypto: Y |

### Edge V8 adapter (edge_v8_adapter.py — 700+ lines):
- V8 engine detection via `py_mini_racer`
- Pure JS implementations of SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, UUID, cache, env
- Multi-pass HTTP fetch (V8 is synchronous — throws `__YIELD_FETCH__`, Python catches, does HTTP, re-evals)
- Thread-safe KV storage (threading.Lock)
- scrypt-based authenticated encryption (not XOR)
- 30s execution timeout via daemon thread
- gc.collect() on context reload
- Configurable max fetch passes (TW_MAX_FETCH_PASSES, default 10, range 1-50)

---

## 14. MODULE BOUNDARIES (module_boundaries.py)

Classifies imports as SERVER, CLIENT, or SHARED:
- **SERVER**: .twm files, lib/ modules, database, filesystem, secrets
- **CLIENT**: npm packages, browser APIs, DOM, WebSocket clients
- **SHARED**: types, validation, pure utilities

### ImportClassifier:
- `classify_import(path)` — classify by import path
- `classify_module_source(source, file_path)` — classify by source code analysis (with caching)
- `validate_imports(imports)` — check for boundary violations
- `get_client_imports(imports)` — filter for client bundles
- `get_server_imports(imports)` — filter for server modules
- `scan_source_imports(source, file_path)` — scan for import/require/dynamic import()

### BoundaryViolation dataclass:
- code (TW2000/TW2001), message, file, line, col, suggestion, severity

### ImportInfo dataclass:
- path, line, col, file, context, boundary, is_dynamic

---

## 15. ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `TW_REDIS_URL` | — | Redis URL for distributed SSR cache |
| `TW_MAX_FETCH_PASSES` | 10 | Max HTTP fetch calls per Edge V8 request (1-50) |
| `TW_SSR_CACHE_MAX` | 512 | Max SSR cache entries |
| `TW_AST_CACHE_MAX` | 128 | Max AST cache entries |
| `TW_AST_CACHE_TTL` | 300 | AST cache TTL in seconds |
| `TW_MAX_BODY_SIZE` | 10MB | Max request body size |
| `TW_MAX_FETCH_PASSES` | 10 | Max fetch passes in Edge V8 |
| `NODE_ENV` | — | Node.js environment (exposed to Edge) |

### Env var filtering for Edge runtime:
Only `TW_`, `PUBLIC_`, `EDGE_` prefixed vars and `NODE_ENV` are exposed to JS sandbox.

---

## 16. CONFIGURATION (tw.config)

Indentation-based key:value format:
```
name: My TW Site
site_url: https://example.com
description: A modern TW App Router project
theme: system              # system | light | dark
pretty_urls: true          # /about/ instead of /about.html
search: true                # built-in search index
modular_pipeline: true     # modular compilation
allow_raw_script: true      # allow <script> tags
sitemap: true               # generate sitemap.xml
robots: true                # generate robots.txt
rss: true                   # generate RSS feed
auto_image_alt: true        # auto-generate alt text
```

---

## 17. DEPLOYMENT

### Zero-config deployment:
```bash
tw deploy --provider vercel --prod
tw deploy --provider netlify --prod
tw deploy --provider cloudflare --prod
```

Auto-detects and generates configs for:
- **Vercel** — `vercel.json` with build command and routes
- **Netlify** — `netlify.toml` with build and redirects
- **Cloudflare** — `_redirects` and headers
- **GitHub Pages** — `.nojekyll` and base path
- **Docker** — `Dockerfile` with Python runtime

Use `--dry-run` to preview without deploying.

### Deploy providers:
- local, vercel, cloudflare, netlify, github-pages, docker

## 18. PLUGIN SYSTEM (.twp files)

```bash
tw plugin add seo-booster    # Install plugin
tw plugin list               # List installed plugins
tw plugin search             # Search registry
```

### Plugin lifecycle hooks:
- `beforeBuild` — modify build config before compilation
- `afterBuild` — post-build transformations
- `beforeRoute` — route-level modifications
- `afterRoute` — post-route processing
- `beforeRequest` — per-request hooks

### ExtensionManager:
- `refresh()` — discover and load extensions
- `discover_extension_paths()` — find .twp files
- `dependency_paths()` — get extension dependency paths
- `emit(event_name, **payload)` — emit event to all hooks
- `register_hook(event_name, handler, extension_name)` — register a hook

## 19. REACTIVITY & VDOM (reactivity.py — 936 lines)

### Functions:
- `has_vdom_features(source)` — checks if source uses VDOM
- `should_use_vdom(source, render_mode)` — decides VDOM usage
- `get_vdom_runtime_js()` — VDOM runtime JavaScript (~19KB, under 20KB limit)
- `build_state_init_script(state)` — initializes reactive state
- `has_reactivity(source)` — checks for `state {}` block
- `transform_reactive_attrs(attrs)` — transforms `on:click` etc. to JS
- `parse_state_block(source)` — parses `state { count 0 }` blocks
- `get_reactivity_runtime_js()` — reactivity runtime JS
- `extract_server_actions(source)` — extracts server action definitions
- `build_action_bindings_js(actions)` — builds JS bindings for server actions

### VDOM runtime JS functions:
- `__twEval`, `__twSet`, `__twGet`, `__twWatch`, `__twScheduleUpdate`
- `__twFlush`, `__twDiff`, `__twDiffProps`, `__twDiffChildren`
- `__twCreateElement`, `__twBindEvents`, `__twRenderList`
- `__twInterpolate`, `__twInterpolateNode`, `__twAction`, `__twFetch`
- `__twInit`, `__twSync`

### VNode class:
Virtual DOM node for diffing/patching.

---

## 20. IMAGE OPTIMIZATION (image_optimizer.py)

Requires Pillow (`pip install tw-framework[image]`).

Features:
- WebP variant generation
- Responsive srcset
- Lazy loading
- Auto alt text generation (from filename)
- Multiple format support (WebP, JPEG, PNG, AVIF)
- Quality control

If Pillow not installed, image optimization is silently skipped.

- `base.py` — BaseRuntime, RuntimeCapability, CAPABILITIES
- `registry.py` — RuntimeRegistry, get_runtime, list_runtimes
- `abstractions.py` — StorageAPI, HttpAPI, CryptoAPI, EnvAPI, CacheAPI, tw
- `validator.py` — validate_runtime_compatibility, RuntimeValidationError
- `adapters/node_adapter.py` — NodeRuntime
- `adapters/python_adapter.py` — PythonRuntime
- `adapters/edge_v8_adapter.py` — EdgeV8Runtime (700+ lines)
- `adapters/edge_adapter.py` — EdgeRuntime (legacy)
- `adapters/wasm_adapter.py` — WasmRuntime

### tw_auth/:
- `session.py` — SessionManager, Session
- `middleware.py` — AuthMiddleware, require_auth, require_role
- `client.py` — AuthClient
- `runtime.py` — auth client runtime JS
